tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang chog ye shes

chu bo bzhugs so/ / dngos grub rgya mtsho mtha' yas ldan/ /bla ma kun la phyag 'tshal te/ / shin tu spros pa med pa yi/ /dbang bskur cho ga bshad par bya/ /'di la sngon 'gro spyod pa brtsams pa dang*/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba gnyis las/ dang po ni bla ma la phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ dpon slob kun stod g.yogs phud la/ slob ma dag bla ma'i sku sngo nag mche ba gtsigs shing*/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rus pas brgyan pa'i spyi bor laṃ ser po/ dpral bar e mthing ga /lkog mar su ser po/ mgrin par khaṃ dud kha/ nu ma gnyis la ha ser po/ lte bar raṃ dmar po/ rkang mthil gnyis su yaṃ ljang gu bsam du bcug la/ bla ma'i snying nang nas hūm̐ mthing ga 'phros te slob ma'i snying nang du gnas par bsam zhing*/ bla mas/ ha ha zhes ngar bskyed la lan gsum brjod nas/ slob ma dag gtor chung re khyer te lung stong so sor song la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams dang*/ de gzhi bdag la phul bas bdag lung pa 'dir sems can thams cad kyi don du 'khor 'das ru shan 'byed pa'i spyod pa zhag gsum byed pas bar du gcod pa mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas lus gcer bu ḍā ma ru dang bcas pas/ sngar gyi dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang la/ lus mchongs pa dang*/ rgyug pa dang*/ 'khrab pa dang*/ nyal ba dang*/ 'phres pa dang*/ bsgyur te 'gro ba la sogs pa/ ngag smra ba/ ngu ba/ rgod pa/ glu len pa/ smre sngags 'don pa/ sngags dang kha ton byed pa/ dud 'gro la sogs pa'i skad brjod pa/ sems bde ba/ sdug bsngal ba/ bar ma/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog /tshong*/ 'khrugs pa/ dgag sgrub/ legs nyes/ chos/ chos ma yin pa/ 'gro ba rigs drug /lam rgyud lnga/ skye ba rnam bzhi la sogs pa'i lus dang*/ yul dang*/ snang ba bsam zhing*/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bde sdug rang gi thog tu bsam la/

de dag gi lus dang*/ ngag dang*/ yid kyi rnam pa rnams dang mthun pa spyad cing gcig tu bsam/ mang por bsgyur/ rags par bsgom/ phra bar spyad/ stong khrol khrol/ yang phyal phyal/ bden med smyon pa'i snang ba ltar ci dran bya zhing*/ sngar byung ba/ da lta byed pa/ phyis 'byung 'gyur/ 'khor 'das kyi chos so cog rang snang sgyu mar spyad do/ /thun 'jog dus lus ngag yid gsum dge ba'i rnam pa/ chos 'chad pa/ phyag /bskor ba la sogs pa zhig la 'phro bzhag nas/ bde ba'i mal du lus mi ro ltar 'gul 'phrigs med/ ngag bem po ltar gleng brjod bral/ sems nam mkha' ltar stong pa'i ngang la rnal bzhag chen por nyal/ de ltar zhag gsum brtson par byas pas/ thun mong dang mchog gi dgos pa gnyis te/ thun mong du lus ngag yid gsum gyi mngon zhen bzlog /bar chad zhi/ sdig pa 'dag go / mchog ni lus ngag yid phyir 'khor bar mi 'jug /sku gsum du grol/ sku gsung thugs kyi klong du mya ngan las 'das so/ / gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ bsham pa dang*/ cho ga / gzengs bstod gsum las/ dang po ni dri yi maṇ+ḍal lnga tshan lngas zlum skor bris pa la/ rin po che dang*/ sman dang*/ spos dang*/ 'bru dang*/ me tog gi tshom bu bkod nas/ tshogs dang gtor ma la sogs pa phyi nang gi mchod rdzas ci 'byor du bsham mo/ /cho ga dngos ni/ slob ma bla ma'i mdun du 'khod de/ stod g.yogs phud/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla mas/ bu khyod su yin/ zhes lan gsum du dris dus/ slob mas/ bdag skal ldan sems kyi bu gcig po lags/ zhes lan brjod dus/ yang bla mas/ de ltar yin phan chad rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i dkyil 'khor bzang zhing nyams dga' ba 'dir bzhugs shig /ces brjod nas/ yang bla mas/ dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug pa'i don du bla ma la gsol ba gdab par bgyi bas rjes zlos mdzod cig / bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams te/

rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las dang*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen pos/ bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ngag byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ yid byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ snang ba byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ smin par mdzad du gsol/ grol bar mdzad du gsol/ gang bar mdzad du gsol/ rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ cher 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsum dang*/ yang*/ kyai sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs ldan pa/ /zag pa rang zad dbyings su sku gshegs pa'i/ /dri ma rang dag dbying nas spyan gzigs la/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /bde gshegs 'jig rten mkhyen pa'i stobs mnga' ba/ /dgongs pa nyag gcig mi g.yo dbyer med kyang*/ /sngon bzhugs dur khrod gnas nas rjes dgongs la/ /rang bzhin mdzad pa gang yang mi mnga' yang*/ /bdag blo mos pa'i don phyir 'dir gshegs shig /e ma ho/ / byin rlabs rtsa ba bla ma brgyud pa yi/ /rim pa nyid kyis rim nas rim zhugs pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po ro langs bde ba dang*/ /mkhyen pa'i thugs ni rab tu sbyangs ldan pa/ /mkhyen rab sprul pa mañdzu mi tra dang*/ /thugs rje chen po 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gcod/ /thugs rje mchog ldan shrī sidha dang*/ /theg pa yongs kyi sgro 'dogs rab chod pa/ /'jig rten mun sel dz+nyā na sū tra dang*/ / skye shi kun bral tshe la dbang thob pa'i/ /mkhas pa chen po bi ma mi tra dang*/ / rtag tu mnyam bzhag rjes thob dbyer med pa'i/ /sems la dbang thob ting 'dzin bzang po dang*/ /rang rgyud 'khrul pa blo la mi gnas pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i bcud ston ldang ma lhun rgyal dang*/ /mkha' 'gros lung bstan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /grub thob chen po seng ge dbang phyug dang*/

/rgyal sras sprul pa 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa/ /rje btsun chen po sprul sku zhang ston dang*//mkhyen pa'i 'od kyi 'jig rten snang mdzad pa/ /ma rig mun sel mkhas pa nyi 'bum dang*/ /bla med rdzogs chen snying po dar mdzad pa/ /mthu stobs dbang phyug gu ru jo 'ber dang*/ /byang chub sems 'byongs 'gro ba'i dpal gyur pa/ /'khrul zhig chen po seng ge rgyab pa dang*/ /gsal stong dbyer med bde chen don rtogs pa/ /zla ba mun sel sbas pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ / dgongs pa mi g.yo chos nyid 'od gsal dang*/ /rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza dang*/ /snying po'i don mthong chos zad rnal 'byor pa/ /klong chen rab 'byams mkhas pa thugs rje can/ /dgongs pa g.yo med mkha' ltar rnam dag cing*/ /'byung ba rang dengs zag med dbyings bzhugs kyang*/ /sngon gyi thugs rje chen po nyid g.yos la/ /thugs rjes dgongs shig bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ gu ru sarba sid+dhi hū ྃ / oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dam pa sangs rgyas kun gyi zhal mthong bdud rtsi'i ro ldan pa/ /ro langs bde ba lha yi lha mchog dam pa nyid/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa 'gro ba'i gdungs ba sel mdzad pa/ /dam pa bdud rtsi bde ba nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin 'jam dpal sku sprul pa/ /nyon mongs rang dag mkhyen pa'i thugs dang ldan/ /gsung gi 'od kyis 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal gcod/ /dam pa yid bzhin myu gu de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi gdung 'dzin mkhas pa sde snod kun gyi bdag /thugs rje chen po'i sprul pa 'dzam gling kun gyi rgyan/ /dri med gsung mnga' 'gro ba ngal gso'i gnas/ /dam pa bshes gnyen myu gu de la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / de yi rjes 'dzin mkhas pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i sprul pa bdag blo'i 'ching gcod pa/ /tshangs pa'i gsungs mnga' 'gro ba kun yid 'phrog /dam pa bde ba'i myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/

/de yi gdung 'dzin mkhas blor skye ba grangs med sbyangs/ /mkhyen rab mchog gyur sde snod kun la rmongs pa med/ /skye shir 'jigs bral sprul pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa/ /dam pa bde gsal myu gu nyid la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin rnam dag sha yi spyan mnga' ba/ /mi rtog bzang po ting 'dzin thugs kyi gnad bkrol nas/ /'dzam gling 'gro rnams ma lus bsam pa'i rgyud mkhyen pa/ /dam pa rtog med myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin skal ldan chos kyi mdzod mnga' ba/ /rin chen gting brnyes 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel/ /bde gshegs bka' dang bla ma'i man ngag snying po 'dzin/ /dam pa pad+ma'i myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin gsang sngags kun gyi mdzod mnga' ba/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes snang byed 'od kyi lus grub nas/ /gdod ma'i zad sar gshegs nas 'gro rnams 'dren pa gang*/ /dam pa ye shes myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin rje btsun 'gro ba rnams kyi mgon/ /gsang sngags dbang bskur lung bstan rjes su 'dzin pa gang*/ /bla med dam chos pad+mo 'gro la rgyas mdzad pa/ /dam pa rin chen myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin 'khor ba'i skyabs gnas dpa' bo nyid/ /'gro ba rnams kyi mgon po dri ma med pa'i dpal/ /yon tan mchog tshogs mkhyen rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /dam pa blo gsal myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin bstan pa'i snying po dar mdzad cing*/ /sa mchog brnyes nas rgyud don kun la dbang 'byor pa/ /'dod dgu'i re ba yongs su sbyin mdzad skye dgu'i dpal/ /dam pa blo mtsho'i myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin ma rig mun pa'i dpung 'joms shing*/ /ye shes 'od zer nyi ma bye ba mtha' yas kyis/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem par byed pa gang*/

/ dam pa snang byed myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin theg pa mchog gi blo gros can/ /ji snyed ji bzhin kun tu gzigs pa mtha' yas kyis/ /yid bzhin 'grub pa'i sa mthor gshegs pa gang yin pa/ /dam pa chos kyi myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin 'od gsal nyi ma'i snying po brnyes/ /bzod dka'i mun nag 'thibs po rab tu 'joms mdzad cing*/ /thugs rje'i 'od zer bye bas 'dzam gling snang mdzad pa/ /dam pa rig 'dzin myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de yi rjes 'dzin sde snod rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin/ /rgyud don nyi ma ting 'dzin 'od gsal mchog tshogs can/ /rang don rdzogs nas gzhan don brtson par mdzad pa gang*/ /dam pa tshogs mchog myu gu mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dngos grub kun 'byung yon tan rgya mtsho'i bla ma la/ /gus pas gsol 'debs thugs rjes byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gu ru na mo/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ dharmā kā ya/ sa man+ta bha drā/ badz+ra bha gi shu na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ sam bho kā ya badz+ra dha ri na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ nirmā kā ya badz+ra sa twa na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ badz+ra pā ṇi na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ pra dz+nyā bha wa gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ mañdzu shrī mi tra gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ shri singha gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ dz+nyā na sū tra gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ bi ma la mi tra gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ sa ma ti b+ta drā gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ bha hri ra he gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/

sing he shwa ra gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ sūr+ya lik+ṣaṃ gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ /ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ jo 'ber gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ lo ki dz+nyā na gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ sa hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ dhe ke badz+ra gu ru na ma/ sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ ku ma rā dza gu ru na mo/ /sa ma ra thā ya sing*/ ma hā sid+dhi sa ma yā/ shī la ma ti gu ru na mo/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ e ma dam pa sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed mdzad ngo bo nyid kyi rje/ /sangs rgyas stong gi dkyil 'khor nyid la dbang bsgyur bla ma nyid/ / badz+ra bha wa lha rje dpa' bo nyid kyi zhal/ /bdag blo'i gti mug mun pa 'joms phyir bstan du gsol/ /'jig rten dri ma'i skyon bral nyes pa kun las grol/ /rang rgyud rnam par dag cing sangs rgyas sum stong gi /thugs la mnga' mdzad mañdzu shrī mi tra'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i zhe sdang ma lus 'joms phyir bstan du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi 'od zer can/ /tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'gro ba 'dam nas 'dren/ /shrī singha mi 'gyur rdo rje'i zhal/ / bdag blo'i nga rgyal zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /theg pa'i don rnams thugs la ji bzhin snang stong pa/ /mi bskyod ye shes 'gro ba'i don la phan brtson gang*/ /dz+nyā na sū tra 'jig rten rmongs pa med ba'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i 'dod chags dri ma zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /mkhyen rab rmad byung sgra tshig rnam pa mang po yis/ /'gro mgon ye shes nyi ma'i 'od kyis 'dzam gling kun tu khyab/ /bi ma mi tra skye shi kun bral rdo rje'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i phrag dog dri ma zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /dgongs pa bar mtshams med pa rlung gi 'gro 'ong zad/ /gnyis med rnam par dag pas gang yang grogs su snang*/ / ting 'dzin bzang po gzung 'dzin bral ba'i zhal/

/bdag blo'i khong khro'i dri ma zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /gdod nas chos kun mnyam nyid ro gcig rtogs gyur bas/ /bdag gzhan dbyer med gzhi nas byang chub dag pa'i ngang*/ /lhun gyi rgyal mtshan bsod nams gzi brjid chen po'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i nyon mongs dug lnga zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /lus ngag yid kyi zhen pa rang logs ste/ /nyams len mthar phyir snang ba zad sar 'khyol/ /seṅge dbang phyug 'khrul snang dag pa'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i 'khrul snang zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /rdo rje theg pa'i snying po gsang sngags sdong por grags/ / nges pa'i don rtogs gnyis med mkha' 'dra'i thugs mnga' ba/ /bkra shis mi 'gyur yid bzhin rdo rje 'chang gi zhal/ /bdag blo'i las dang bag chags zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /'khor ba mu mtha' med pa'i klong dkyil nas/ /chos nyid dag pa kun gsal gcig tu rtogs/ /ye nas lhun mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i gti mug zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /bla med snying po tha ེ ga pa mchog gi de nyid rtogs/ /ting 'dzin mi g.yo ji ltar brtan pa'i dgongs pa can/ /nges don mthar phyin tshad med phrin las bzang po'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i bzang rtog 'dzin pa zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /rang bzhin lhun grub kun gsal chen po dang*/ /'od gsal mngon gyur 'khor 'das bya rtsol bral/ /rtag tu mi g.yo kun tu bzang po'i zhal/ / bdag blo'i ma rig zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i mkha' dbyings su/ /thams cad lhun mnyam mchog gi dngos grub brnyes/ /tshogs bsags rgyal po rang rig dri med zhal/ /bdag blo'i 'khor ba zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /gdod ma'i rang bzhin chos dbyings ngang nyid du/ /ma bcos spros bral 'od gsal 'pho 'gyur med/ khams gsum yongs grol ting 'dzin chen po'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i blang dor zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /yon tan mtha' yas ye shes dpal 'bar zhing*/
/dngos 'dzin rang zhig gzung 'dzin kun las 'das/ /rang grol rgyal po dri med pad+ma'i zhal/ /bdag blo'i 'khrul rtog zad mdzad bstan du gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā

hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas rin po che dang*/ 'bru dang*/ dri dang*/ sman dang*/ spos kyis 'jig rten gang bar dmigs la/ maṇ+ḍal lan lnga phul la/ slob ma kun langs te/ stod g.yogs phud/ thal mo sbyar/ ja ma'i thugs kar mig gtad pa la/ ja mas ā drug brtsegs yengs la bor ba'i mtshams su drag la thung bar brjod la lus 'phar/ ngag gsal/ sems mi rtog pa'i ye shes dbab pa'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug pa ni/ lus gnad de nyid kyis kha shar du gtad pa la/ ja mas dbyangs snyan pos/ /e ma skal ldan shar phyogs kyi nam mkha'i dkyil na phar gam gam song dang*/ zhes pa gsum dang*/ yang 'gro na 'gro sa 'dug gam/ zhes pa brjod do/ /de bzhin du lho dang*/ nub dang*/ byang la'ang ming brjes la brjod pas/ stong nyid bsam ngo dang bral ba'i nyams 'char/ /de nas dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ /ja mas phyag mdzub bsgrengs te nam mkha'i dbyings la yul yul bya zhing*/ e ma skal ldan nam mkha'i dbyings la ltos shig /ces pa gsum brjod do/ /de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ stod g.yogs gyon/ /skyil krung gis 'dug pa la/ snga mas/ e ma nam mkha'i dkyil ya ki na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'phro ba lnga po la shes pa gtod la/ snge mtho je mthor song zhig pa gsum brjod nas/ slar ma ldog cig /gsum brjod pa ni/ rig pa sku gsum ka dag gi dbyings su thim pa'i don ta ོ / / de nas dbang bskur ba dngos ni/ bla ma langs te/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum mdzub mo gnyis mig gnyis la btsugs nas/ a brtsegs mar brjod/ shar dang lho dang nub dang byang du blta'o/ /zhabs brkyang bskum ni 'khor 'das kyi spros pa gcod pa'i brda'o/ /mdzub mo mig la btsugs pa ni/ ye shes mig nas 'char ba'i brda'o/ /phyogs bzhir lta ba ni snang bzhi mthar phyin par byed pa'i brda'o/ /a ni skye med du grol ba'i brda'o/ /de nas mdzub mo nam mkhar bsgrengs te mig hur byung la/

nam mkha' ni rgya che'o/ / zhes pa gsum brjod do/ /nam mkha' ni dbyings kyi brda'o/ /mdzub mo rig pa lu gu rgyud kyi brda'o/ /mig har po gzigs stangs kyi brda'o/ /rgya chen po spros bral rang byung gi ye shes kyi brda'o/ /de dag gis dbang gi dngos gzhi bstan to/ /gsum pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ /shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang bskur ba thob nas chos sku'i zhing la spyod/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag/ rang rig bhan+dha 'bar ba'i khro bo'i zhing la dbang thob/ /'bad na tshe 'dir grol zhing*/ khregs chod stong nyid bsgom pa la dbang*/ ma 'bad kyang bar do 'am phyi ma la grol ba nges pa yin no/ /zhes brjod nas tshogs kyi dga' ba bya'o/ /de ltar shin tu spros med kyi/ /dbang mchog rgyal po thob pa des/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang*/ /'gro kun bde legs phun tshogs shog /shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang chog ye shes chu bo zhes bya ba/ theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa/ klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi mgul/ kun tu bzang po'i khang bzangs su bkod pa rdzogs so// //dge'o/ / dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (11) shin tu spros pa med pa'i dbang chog ye shes chu bo/ -PAGE 92--PAGE 93--PAGE 90-
